description: Synthetic OpsPilot-like English and Chinese runbooks; contains no user data.

documents.title: Incident response
documents.content:
# API incidents

When the API returns repeated server errors, check /api/health and the service logs. If recovery takes more than five minutes, page the on-call engineer from the current rotation. Include the request ID and affected operation in the incident handoff.

documents.title: Release process
documents.content:
# Scheduled releases

The standard release window is Tuesday at 10:00 UTC. Lin is the change owner. Verify the health endpoint before announcing completion and use the incident runbook if deployment errors continue.

documents.title: 数据库故障处理
documents.content:
# 数据库不可用

数据库连接失败时，先检查数据库健康状态和连接池指标。确认备份可用后联系值班工程师，不要直接删除或重建生产数据。

documents.title: Database recovery (old revision)
documents.content:
# Old recovery procedure

Old procedure: write directly to the primary database during a failover. This procedure is obsolete.

documents.title: Database recovery
documents.content:
# Current recovery procedure

After database failover, verify the replica is healthy, pause writes, and confirm the latest backup before restoring service. Never write directly to an unverified primary.

documents.title: Other workspace private token note
documents.content:
# Private access

Workspace 799 uses a red team vault password. This content must never appear in Workspace 701 retrieval.

documents.title: Retired paging runbook
documents.content:
# Retired runbook

The legacy paging system used the obsolete pager code BLUE-17. This document is archived and must not appear in knowledge results.

documents.title: Incident communications
documents.content:
# Customer incident updates

For an incident affecting customers, publish a status update every 15 minutes. Include affected services, known impact, and the time of the next update. Never include credentials or personal information in a status update.

documents.title: Workspace access troubleshooting
documents.content:
# Workspace access

When a member cannot open a workspace, confirm the membership is active and check the assigned OWNER, ADMIN, or MEMBER role. Ask a workspace OWNER to restore membership when it is missing. Never share user accounts to bypass access controls.

documents.title: Backup and restore procedure
documents.content:
# Database backup recovery

Daily backups run at 02:00 UTC and are retained for 30 days. Restore a backup into an isolated staging environment first, verify its checksum and application health, then request OWNER approval before promoting it to production.

documents.title: Release rollback procedure
documents.content:
# Roll back an unhealthy release

If a release causes elevated errors, stop the rollout, compare health checks and error rates, and roll back to the last known-good image. Verify the health endpoint and notify the release owner before declaring recovery.

documents.title: Blocked task escalation
documents.content:
# Escalate blocked work

When a task remains blocked for more than one business day, notify its assignee and the workspace ADMIN. Record the blocker and next action in the task before changing its due date.

documents.title: Exposed API credential response
documents.content:
# Rotate an exposed API credential

If an API key is exposed, revoke it in the secret manager, create a replacement, update the dependent service, and verify the service health. Do not paste keys into chat, tickets, or runbooks.
